children: Merit Medical Systems reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $416.2 million, up 8.4% from a year earlier. Net income rose 52.4% to $42.3 million, and diluted earnings per share increased to $0.7 from $0.46.
Revenue was $416.2M, compared with $384.2M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 8.4%.
Net income was $42.3M, compared with $27.8M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 52.4%.
Diluted EPS was $0.70, compared with $0.46 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 52.2%.
Nine-month revenue increased 8.5% to $1.217 billion, with growth in domestic and international markets.
Third-quarter therapeutic sales grew 14%, led by endoscopy, OEM, oncology and cardiac therapies; renal therapies declined.
Nine-month foundational sales rose 6.4%, led by vascular intervention and access, while procedural solutions declined following the DualCap product-line sale.
Merit acquired View Point on April 1. OneMark products began selling in the third quarter, with broader availability expected through 2026 and into 2027.
Inventory investment increased to support customer service, acquired products and supply buffers. The company expects 2026 capital spending of $60 million to $70 million.
